water_source: Spring - P. C. Bryce, U. S. Forest Service
notes: Report's own numbering: Station 95 (not a USGS station number). Heading 'SPRING - P. C. BRYCE, U. S. FOREST SERVICE'. Description: Plank-curbed and covered pool in alluvium on sandstone in creek bottom. Altitude about 2,900 feet. Discharge printed in second-feet and gals. per min.; first row 'Practically dry'. Last row 'Apr. 13 (9:15 a.m.)' has no year printed; it follows Feb. 10, 1949, so 1949. No place, county or state on the page.
